{'type': 'text', 'text': 'import datetime
import re
import streamlit as st

st.set_page_config(
    page_title="Banking Party Master - Party Entry",
    page_icon="🏦",
    layout="wide"
)

st.title("🏦 Banking Party Master")
st.subheader("Party Record Entry Form")
st.caption("Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required.")

with st.form(key="party_form", clear_on_submit=False):
    st.markdown("### Identification Details")
    col1, col2 = st.columns(2)

    with col1:
        id_prim = st.text_input(
            "Primary Party Identifier *",
            max_chars=50,
            help="Unique primary identifier for the party."
        )
        first_name = st.text_input(
            "First Name *",
            max_chars=100,
            help="First name of the party."
        )
        plss = st.selectbox(
            "Prospect or Active Status *",
            options=["", "Active", "Prospect", "Suspended", "Terminated"],
            help="Current status of the party."
        )

    with col2:
        aadhaar_no = st.text_input(
            "Aadhaar Number *",
            max_chars=12,
            help="12-digit Aadhaar Number."
        )
        last_name = st.text_input(
            "Last Name *",
            max_chars=100,
            help="Last name of the party."
        )

    st.markdown("---")
    st.markdown("### Tax & Personal Information")
    col3, col4 = st.columns(2)

    with col3:
        tax_id_type = st.selectbox(
            "Tax Identification Type",
            options=["", "PAN", "SSN", "TIN", "EIN"],
            help="Type of Tax Identification."
        )
        dob = st.date_input(
            "Date of Birth",
            value=None,
            min_value=datetime.date(1900, 1, 1),
            max_value=datetime.date.today(),
            help="Date of Birth of the party."
        )

    with col4:
        tax_id = st.text_input(
            "Tax Identification Number",
            max_chars=50,
            help="Tax Identification Number corresponding to type."
        )

    st.markdown("---")
    st.markdown("### Contact Information")
    col5, col6 = st.columns(2)

    with col5:
        phone_number = st.text_input(
            "Phone Number",
            max_chars=20,
            help="Primary phone number."
        )
        email_id = st.text_input(
            "Email Address",
            max_chars=100,
            help="Primary email address."
        )

    with col6:
        alternate_phone = st.text_input(
            "Alternate Phone Number",
            max_chars=20,
            help="Secondary phone number."
        )

    st.markdown("---")
    st.markdown("### Address Details")
    col7, col8 = st.columns(2)

    with col7:
        legal_addr = st.text_area(
            "Legal Address",
            max_chars=255,
            height=100,
            help="Official legal address."
        )

    with col8:
        prim_addr = st.text_area(
            "Primary Address",
            max_chars=255,
            height=100,
            help="Primary correspondence address."
        )

    submitted = st.form_submit_button("Submit Party Record", use_container_width=True)

if submitted:
    errors = []

    # Mandatory field validation
    if not id_prim.strip():
        errors.append("Primary Party Identifier (id_prim) is required.")
    if not plss.strip():
        errors.append("Prospect or Active Status (plss) is required.")
    if not first_name.strip():
        errors.append("First Name is required.")
    if not last_name.strip():
        errors.append("Last Name is required.")
    
    # Aadhaar validation
    if not aadhaar_no.strip():
        errors.append("Aadhaar Number is required.")
    elif not (aadhaar_no.isdigit() and len(aadhaar_no) == 12):
        errors.append("Aadhaar Number must be exactly 12 numeric digits.")

    # Optional Email validation
    if email_id.strip():
        email_regex = r"^[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+\.\w+$"
        if not re.match(email_regex, email_id.strip()):
            errors.append("Please provide a valid email address.")

    # Display errors or submit success
    if errors:
        for err in errors:
            st.error(err)
    else:
        st.success("Party record validated and submitted successfully!")
        
        record_data = {
            "id_prim": id_prim.strip(),
            "plss": plss,
            "first_name": first_name.strip(),
            "last_name": last_name.strip(),
            "tax_id_type": tax_id_type if tax_id_type else None,
            "tax_id": tax_id.strip() if tax_id.strip() else None,
            "dob": str(dob) if dob else None,
            "legal_addr": legal_addr.strip() if legal_addr.strip() else None,
            "prim_addr": prim_addr.strip() if prim_addr.strip() else None,
            "phone_number": phone_number.strip() if phone_number.strip() else None,
            "email_id": email_id.strip() if email_id.strip() else None,
            "aadhaar_no": aadhaar_no.strip(),
            "alternate_phone": alternate_phone.strip() if alternate_phone.strip() else None,
        }
        
        st.subheader("Submitted Record Summary")
        st.json(record_data)', 'extras': {'signature': ''}}
